title: Team IDs
prompt: A TypeScript lookup step needs only ids from teams. Write a typed function that returns the id values in their original order.

explanation.beginner:
Example: teamIds([{"id":"1","label":"One"},{"id":"2","label":"Two"}]) produces ["1","2"]. Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Compare “handles empty arrays”: input [[]] produces []. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Tempting mistake: A projection is different from filtering: returning a boolean from map gives booleans, while returning a value from filter only makes a keep decision.

The reference uses map. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “handles empty arrays”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
